originalRequest:
Please plan and implement this multi-module invoice feature in this existing Node ES module repository. Review the code before planning; produce the Tokage plan, not implementation during planning.
subtotal(items) in pricing.mjs must sum integer priceCents * integer quantity, return 0 for empty input and throw RangeError for negative or non-integer prices/quantities. Zero values are valid. money(cents) in format.mjs must produce dollar strings with exactly two digits, no thousands separator, and a leading minus before the dollar sign for negatives (e.g. -105 => -$1.05). invoice(items) in invoice.mjs must compose imports of those two public functions and return "Total: " plus the formatted subtotal, propagating errors.
Arrange independent pricing and formatting work so it can run in parallel, followed by integration that consumes both results. Record their cross-module public contracts. The environment is prepared with npm ci before execution. Use npm run test:pricing, npm run test:format, npm run test:integration for the respective work, and include npm test on the integration task for the final full gate. Do not edit tests, package files, configuration or add dependencies. Only pricing.mjs, format.mjs, invoice.mjs may change. Execution agents should use file tools only; Tokage runs shell acceptance independently. Preserve public exports and use the required TaskReport format after execution. No model fallback.

parts.text:
# Spec

## Goals

Implement the invoice feature across the existing pricing, formatting, and invoice modules. Keep pricing and formatting work independent so they can proceed in parallel; integration follows and composes both public functions.

## Scope

- In scope: `subtotal(items)`, `money(cents)`, and `invoice(items)` in their existing modules.
- Out of scope: tests, package files, configuration, dependencies, and all other files.

## Key decisions

- Keep each public function in its existing module and preserve its named export.
- Validate each price and quantity as a non-negative integer; zero is valid. Sum their products in integer cents.
- Format cents as dollars with exactly two fractional digits, no grouping, and a minus before `$` for negative values.
- Let `invoice(items)` propagate errors from `subtotal`.

# Contracts

## C1 Pricing public API

```ts
type InvoiceItem = { priceCents: number; quantity: number };

function subtotal(items: InvoiceItem[]): number;
// Returns the sum of priceCents * quantity, or 0 for empty input.
// Throws RangeError if any priceCents or quantity is negative or non-integer.
// Zero values are valid.
```

## C2 Formatting public API

```ts
function money(cents: number): string;
// Formats cents as dollars with exactly two decimal digits and no thousands separator.
// Negative values use a leading minus before the dollar sign, e.g. -105 -> "-$1.05".
```

## C3 Invoice public API

```ts
function invoice(items: InvoiceItem[]): string;
// Returns "Total: " + money(subtotal(items)).
// Propagates errors from subtotal.
```

## C4 Directory conventions

- Pricing: `pricing.mjs`, named export `subtotal`.
- Formatting: `format.mjs`, named export `money`.
- Integration: `invoice.mjs`, named export `invoice`; import the public functions from `./pricing.mjs` and `./format.mjs`.
- Only these three module files may be changed.

# Tasks

```yaml
- id: P0.M1a
  domain: backend-api
  title: Implement pricing subtotal
  goal: Implement subtotal(items) with integer-cent multiplication, empty input handling, and RangeError validation for negative or non-integer prices and quantities.
  depends_on: []
  contracts: [C1]
  write_scope: ["pricing.mjs"]
  deliverables: ["Named subtotal export with the C1 behavior"]
  acceptance:
    commands: ["npm run test:pricing"]
    criteria: ["Pricing acceptance command passes"]
  size: S
  difficulty: 1
- id: P0.M1b
  domain: backend-api
  title: Implement money formatting
  goal: Implement money(cents) as a dollar string with exactly two decimal digits, no thousands separator, and a leading minus before the dollar sign for negative values.
  depends_on: []
  contracts: [C2]
  write_scope: ["format.mjs"]
  deliverables: ["Named money export with the C2 behavior"]
  acceptance:
    commands: ["npm run test:format"]
    criteria: ["Formatting acceptance command passes"]
  size: S
  difficulty: 1
- id: P0.M2
  domain: integration
  title: Integrate invoice total
  goal: Compose subtotal and money from their public module exports so invoice(items) returns the required total string and propagates pricing errors.
  depends_on: [P0.M1a, P0.M1b]
  contracts: [C1, C2, C3, C4]
  write_scope: ["invoice.mjs"]
  deliverables: ["Named invoice export using imports from pricing.mjs and format.mjs"]
  acceptance:
    commands: ["npm run test:integration", "npm test"]
    criteria: ["Integration acceptance command passes", "Full test suite passes"]
  size: S
  difficulty: 1
```

# Notes

Execution agents must use file tools only. Tokage runs the listed shell acceptance commands independently. Do not edit tests, package files, configuration, or add dependencies. Preserve public exports. After execution, use the required TaskReport format. No model fallback.
